$comment: Area metadata for the generated API reference. eng/api-layout.ps1 reads this to place each namespace in its own folder and to write that folder's index. 'families' names the GDK API families the namespace projects; each entry is resolved to a Microsoft Learn URL through eng/gdk-learn-index.json.

GDK.Net.title: Core runtime
GDK.Net.summary: Initialising and shutting down the Gaming Runtime, querying which runtime features are available, and the error model every other area reports through.

GDK.Net.Accessibility.title: Accessibility
GDK.Net.Accessibility.summary: Player accessibility preferences: closed-caption styling, high-contrast mode, speech synthesis and speech-to-text.

GDK.Net.Activation.title: Activation
GDK.Net.Activation.summary: How a title is launched: protocol and URI activation, and the invite and activation arguments the shell passes in.

GDK.Net.Capture.title: Capture
GDK.Net.Capture.summary: Screenshots, game clips and broadcast state, including the developer-only diagnostic capture paths.

GDK.Net.Events.title: Game events
GDK.Net.Events.summary: Writing title-defined telemetry events declared in the title's game configuration.

GDK.Net.GameSave.title: Game save
GDK.Net.GameSave.summary: Cloud-synchronised save containers and blobs, and the file-system view over them.

GDK.Net.GameUI.title: Game UI
GDK.Net.GameUI.summary: System-provided dialogs: the account picker, error and message dialogs, text entry, gamertag pickers and the web authentication flow.

GDK.Net.Networking.title: Networking
GDK.Net.Networking.summary: Connectivity hints and the network security configuration a title must honour before it opens a socket.

GDK.Net.Package.title: Package
GDK.Net.Package.summary: Package and chunk enumeration, mounting, install monitoring and licence checks for downloadable content.

GDK.Net.PlayFab.title: PlayFab core and services
GDK.Net.PlayFab.summary: PlayFab initialisation, the entity handle every service call authenticates with, and the generated service layer (economy, data, profiles, statistics and the rest).

GDK.Net.PlayFab.Multiplayer.title: PlayFab Multiplayer
GDK.Net.PlayFab.Multiplayer.summary: Lobbies and matchmaking, drained through the PlayFab Multiplayer state-change pump.

GDK.Net.PlayFab.Party.title: PlayFab Party
GDK.Net.PlayFab.Party.summary: Realtime networking, voice and text transport, and the XBOX Live identity bridge that authorises Party chat controls.

GDK.Net.Storage.title: Storage
GDK.Net.Storage.summary: The persistent local storage folder a title may write to outside its package.

GDK.Net.Store.title: Store
GDK.Net.Store.summary: Commerce: licences, durables, add-ons, in-game purchase, catalogue queries and the licence-lost notification.

GDK.Net.Streaming.title: Game streaming
GDK.Net.Streaming.summary: Detecting a cloud-streaming client and reading its properties, so a title can adapt to the streamed presentation.

GDK.Net.SystemInfo.title: System information
GDK.Net.SystemInfo.summary: Console, operating system and application information, the analytics identifier, display mode and HDR capability.

GDK.Net.Users.title: Users
GDK.Net.Users.summary: Sign-in and identity: adding users, privileges, tokens, and the user-change and sign-out deferral events that gate every user-scoped API.

GDK.Net.XboxLive.title: XBOX Live services
GDK.Net.XboxLive.summary: XBOX Live through XSAPI: context and initialisation, profile, social, presence, achievements, leaderboards, statistics, title storage, privacy and multiplayer activity.
